part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `new_receiver` (tokio/src/sync/broadcast.rs:661): when a channel is closed, `send2(None)` writes the closed flag into the slot at `tail.pos` and then advances `tail.pos`. A receiver created afterwards started at the new `tail.pos`, pointing at a stale slot from an old buffer generation, so `recv` parked forever (and `try_recv` returned `Empty` instead of `Closed`).

The fix: if `tail.closed`, the new receiver's cursor points at the closed slot (`tail.pos - 1`), so the first `recv`/`try_recv` returns `Closed` immediately. Verified:
- `cargo test -p tokio --test sync_broadcast`: all 25 tests pass, including `resubscribe_to_closed_channel`.
- The issue's exact repro program now prints `Closed` instead of hanging.
- Doctest/lib-test failures were confirmed pre-existing (missing `macros` feature in this environment) via `git stash`.
